synth.final_message:
`python3 check.py` prints ALL PASS: all 19 transitions replay exactly.

The rule in `program.py`:

| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| 3 | Moves the cursor to the previous glyph column, and wraps from the first column to the last. |
| 4 | Moves the cursor to the next glyph column, and wraps from the last column to the first. |
| 1, 2 | No visible change. |
| 5, 6, 7 | Not in the data, so they do nothing. |

Actions 1 and 2 possibly change the letter of the selected glyph. I cannot confirm this, because the extractor does not record pixels. The header comment of `program.py` states this hypothesis.
